Initial release of yotta-secret: a zero-dependency, offline key/credential leak scanner.

- Detects suspected API keys, secrets, private keys, tokens in code, config, .env, logs, and git history using regex + entropy + format validation.
- Supports five types: cloud vendor keys, private keys, credentials, URL-embedded secrets, and generic high-entropy tokens.
- Provides output in text, JSON, and CSV formats; secrets are masked by default for safety.
- Pure local/offline scan: does not verify key validity online or send any data externally.
- Usage includes scan (file/dir/stdin/git), verify (single value), mask (redact secrets in text), and entropy calculations.
- Emphasizes ethical use: only on authorized/self-owned assets or for educational environments.
